data.name: widget_custom_subtitle_explanation
data.value:
Tzemreḍ ad tessekcamḍ kra i k-yeɛǧben, maca ḥader ɣef teɣzi n tefrit. Ma tebɣiḍ ad d-tawiḍ isallen n tegnit, ma ulac akken, seqdec $ i ussekteɣ ɣef wawal n telɣut.
Amedya, “Current weather is: $cw$.” ad d-yeffeɣ s talɣa n “Current weather is: Clear sky.”.
